policy_title: Uphold Overseas Territories' Sovereignty and Rights
stated: Labour will always defend the sovereignty and right to self-determination of the British Overseas Territories and Crown Dependencies, including the Falklands and Gibraltar.

source.quote: Defending our security also means protecting the British Overseas Territories and Crown Dependencies, including the Falklands and Gibraltar. Labour will always defend their sovereignty and right to self-determination.

bearing_set.reason: Committing to defend the sovereignty of the Falklands, Gibraltar and other Overseas Territories is directly a national-security and defence-posture statement, bearing on the UK's resilience to external territorial threats.

The explicit pledge to uphold the 'right to self-determination' of overseas territory residents is a democratic-rights commitment — it affirms the binding weight of referendums (e.g. the 2013 Falklands referendum) and protects the residents' right to determine their own political future, a genuine O9 democratic-rights verdict.

membership_note: Two clear bearings: the defence/security dimension (O5) and the self-determination/democratic-rights dimension (O9). No specific new spending is pledged so O12 does not earn a real verdict; domestic liberty, inequality, or cost-of-living effects are negligible.
